lines: 你不可为恶所胜，
反要以善胜恶。
Do not let evil overcome you
but overcome evil by good.
信心软弱的，你们要接纳，
但不要辩论所疑惑的事。
Do not put on one side him who is feeble in faith
and do not put him in doubt by your reasonings.
你若因食物叫弟兄忧愁，
就不是按着爱人的道理行。基督已经替他死，
你不可因你的食物叫他败坏。
And if because of food your brother is troubled
then you are no longer going on in the way of love. Do not let your food be destruction to him for whom Christ went into death.
我们既因信称义，
就借着我们的主耶稣基督得与神相和。
For which reason
because we have righteousness through faith
let us be at peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
如今，那些在基督耶稣里的就不定罪了。
因为赐生命圣灵的律，在基督耶稣里释放了我，使我脱离罪和死的律了。
For this cause those who are in Christ Jesus will not be judged as sinners.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.
因为我深信无论是死，是生，是天使，是掌权的，是有能的，是现在的事，是将来的事，
是高处的，是低处的，是别的受造之物，都不能叫我们与神的爱隔绝；这爱是在我们的主基督耶稣里的。
For I am certain that not death, or life, or angels, or rulers, or things present, or things to come, or powers,
Or things on high, or things under the earth, or anything which is made, will be able to come between us and the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
［新娘］愿他用口与我亲嘴；
因你的爱情比酒更美。
Let him give me the kisses of his mouth: for his love is better than wine.
［新郎］我的佳偶在女子中，
好像百合花在荆棘内。
As the lily-flower among the thorns of the waste
so is my love among the daughters.
［新娘］求你将我放在你心上如印记，带在你臂上如戳记。因为爱情如死之坚强，嫉恨如阴间之残忍；所发的电光是火焰的电光，是耶和华的烈焰。
爱情，众水不能息灭，大水也不能淹没。若有人拿家中所有的财宝要换爱情，就全被藐视。
Put me as a sign on your heart, as a sign on your arm; love is strong as death, and wrath bitter as the underworld: its coals are coals of fire; violent are its flames.
Much water may not put out love, or the deep waters overcome it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would be judged a price not great enough.
不要毁谤，不要争竞，
总要和平，向众人大显温柔。
To say no evil of any man
not to be fighters
to give way to others
to be gentle in behaviour to all men.
无用的牧人丢弃羊群有祸了！刀必临到他的膀臂和右眼上。他的膀臂必全然枯干；
他的右眼也必昏暗失明。」
A curse on the foolish keeper who goes away from the flock! the sword will be on his arm and on his right eye: his arm will become quite dry and his eye will be made completely dark.
「万军之耶和华曾对你们的列祖如此说：『要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。
不可欺压寡妇、孤儿、寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。』」
This is what the Lord of armies has said: Let your judging be upright and done in good faith, let every man have mercy and pity for his brother:
Do not be hard on the widow, or the child without a father, on the man from a strange country, or on the poor; let there be no evil thought in your heart against your brother.
